name: @sylphx/anymd-linux-x64-gnu
description: Optional pure-Rust MCP server binary for linux-x64-gnu. Installed as an optionalDependency of @sylphx/anymd. Sole-Rust; fail-closed if missing.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');const bin=p.anymdNativeBinary;if(!bin||!fs.existsSync(bin)||fs.statSync(bin).size<1024){console.error('REFUSE PUBLISH: native binary missing or empty at',bin);process.exit(1)}console.log('native binary present:',bin,'bytes',fs.statSync(bin).size);"
